messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Greenhaven renewal hit a snag. Procurement sent a PO but the original signatory left; PO number on their side is pending. They mentioned GH-PO-58943 in the email but the signer field is blank. Legal needs delegated-signer authorization. Can we get an interim e-sign path so we don't block provisioning?

Liam Ortiz: Got it. Do we have the attached PO doc? If so, we could accept with a delegated-signer addendum and amend later. Quick question — procurement ok with email auth instead of SSO?

Priya Nair: Legal is fine with delegated signer provided we receive an authorization email from an exec + org chart showing delegated authority. Also the amendment must reference the original contract ID and include the delegated-signer form.

Jordan Park: Finance note — they requested NET60 but procurement is pushing NET90. From a revenue perspective we prefer NET60. If procurement insists on NET90 we need a plan for cash — maybe prepay for onboarding or a short-term invoice schedule.

Maya Chen: Procurement attached a PDF but the signer field is empty. I've asked their admin to confirm the delegated signer and to send authorization email. If they provide GH-PO-58943 and the authorization we can accept NET60. If not, they said they'd only sign NET90.

esign-bot: Docusign: Envelope 0x9a2 failed SSO redirect for greenhaven_admin@greenhaven.com — error 401. Automatic retry queued.

Liam Ortiz: Re-triggering might not help if their IdP is blocking. Can we switch that envelope to email auth for now? That would avoid the SSO 401 and speed things up.

Priya Nair: Email authentication is acceptable for the delegated signer so long as we capture the audit trail and keep the authorization email attached to the contract. Also ensure the amendment language explicitly states delegated authority and references GH-PO-58943 (or final PO when issued).

Maya Chen: OK reissuing envelope with email auth and attaching a delegated-signer addendum template. I'll ask them to upload the org chart and exec authorization. If they supply GH-PO-58943 we can close on NET60. If procurement sticks to NET90, suggest split: first 3 months prepay or 15-day net for onboarding.

Jordan Park: I can approve a one-off 15-day onboarding invoice up to $5k to unblock provisioning, revenue exception code REX-122. Finance will log it.

Liam Ortiz: I'll coordinate with the buyer and confirm whether the delegated signer is ready. Sales flagged that infra is standing by to provision Dedicated once contract is signed and KMS onboarding is scheduled.

Maya Chen: Reissued envelope now — posting link and tagging procurement. If they send the authorization email before EOD we should be able to close today.

esign-bot: Docusign: New envelope 0x9b3 created with email auth. Link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0x9b3

Maya Chen: Link posted to procurement. Tagging @Priya Nair to confirm amendment language once they sign.

Priya Nair: Will review the executed amendment and confirm legal sign-off. Thanks everyone!
